issues: The UI primary flow validation fails at step 65: the "Select backup file" upload button does not trigger a detectable file‑chooser event. In src/screens/RestoreScreen.tsx the pickFile implementation creates a hidden <input> element and calls input.click() only on web, while on native platforms it uses expo-document-picker. The UI flow test runs on both phone and desktop emulations and expects a file‑chooser to open when the button labelled "Select backup file" is clicked. Because the file input is hidden (and possibly not considered visible by the test harness) or the click is not recognized as a file‑chooser trigger, the test times out. Fix the implementation so that the button directly renders a visible <input type="file"> (or a styled component that forwards the file‑chooser event) with the correct accessible name/label, ensuring Playwright can detect the file‑chooser. Alternatively, replace the custom hidden‑input logic with a React Native Web <input> element that is attached to the DOM and uses the "file" type and proper label, or adjust the test harness expectations to match the current implementation. The fix must make the step pass for both phone and desktop sizes.

feedback": "All acceptance tests pass, but static validation fails due to the UI flow step involving the restore file upload. Update the restore screen file‑picker handling so the upload button reliably opens a file chooser that the UI‑flow test can detect (e.g., use a visible <input type='file'> with appropriate aria-label or integrate expo-document-picker in a way recognized by the test harness).
